name: FEX x86 RootFS
summary: x86 RootFS image for FEX library forwarding (proot-safe extract)
description: Downloads FEX x86 RootFS (~1.3 GiB EroFS), extracts it (required without FUSE/proot), and writes FEX_ROOTFS for user flux. Depends on fex-emu (needs FEXRootFSFetcher). Install this for a working FEX stack on ARM64.
